prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: The provision for credit losses was $24.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $17.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The provision for credit losses consists of provisions for both funded loans and for unfunded lending commitments. The provision for credit losses for funded loans was $27.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 which reflects specific reserves on certain individually assessed loans primarily in the commercial and industrial - non-RE portfolio, partially offset by a benefit in the Commercial Real Estate portfolio resulting from an improved macroeconomic outlook in the forecast scenarios used in the allowance for credit losses model.

pretax.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Banking Business Segment had income before income taxes of $176.1 million, compared to income before income taxes of $153.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

tax.heading: Provision for Income Taxes
tax.text: Income tax expense was $45.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $37.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Our effective income tax rates for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 were 25.98% and 25.04%, respectively.

net.text: We define “adjusted earnings”, a non-GAAP financial measure, as net income without the after-tax impact of non-recurring acquisition-related items (including amortization of intangible assets related to acquisitions) and other costs (unusual or non-recurring charges). Adjusted EPS, a non-GAAP financial measure, is calculated by dividing non-GAAP adjusted earnings by the average number of diluted common shares outstanding during the period. We believe the non-GAAP measures of adjusted earnings and Adjusted EPS provide useful information about the Company’s operating performance. We believe excluding the non-recurring acquisition-related costs and other costs provides investors with an alternative understanding of our core business.

ocf.text: During the three months ended September 30, 2026, we had net cash inflows from operating activities of $294.9 million compared to inflows of $118.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Net operating cash inflows and outflows fluctuate primarily due to the timing of the following: originations of loans held for sale, proceeds from loan sales, securities borrowed and loaned, and customer, broker-dealer and clearing receivables and payables and changes in other assets and payables.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text:
For the three months ended September 30, 2026, net interest income totaled $331.3 million, an increase of $40.2 million, or 13.8%, compared to net interest income of $291.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, net interest margin decreased by 11 basis points to 4.64%, compared to the net interest margin of 4.75% for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

For the three months ended September 30, 2026, total interest and dividend income increased 11.0% from the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to higher interest earned on loans, primarily reflecting higher average balances, partially offset by a $17.4 million decrease in interest income on deposits in other financial institutions.

For the three months ended September 30, 2026, total interest expense increased 6.4% from the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to an increase in interest expense on FHLB advances and secured financings.

intro.text: Our Company is a technology-driven, diversified financial services company with approximately $30.0 billion in assets and approximately $47.8 billion of assets under custody and/or administration at Axos Clearing LLC (“Axos Clearing”). Our client-centric, technology-enabled services model provides secure and scalable banking, clearing and custody, and investment advisory solutions to retail and business customers. The Bank provides consumer and commercial banking products and services through its digital online and mobile banking platforms, low-cost distribution channels and affinity partners.
